# Ghoul Perks: All new perk cards for ghouls

![Ghoul Perks: All new perk cards for ghouls](/uploads/446_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

*PTS as of: March 13, 2025 | Release: March 18, 2025*

The new playable ghoul can currently be tested on the current PTS (Public Test Server). You can become a ghoul yourself. This not only brings with it visual changes, but also new abilities and the "Feral Meter", which represents your "glow" over 100% health. Of course there are also numerous new perk cards and also 2 new legendary perks. These ghoul perks often work with the "glow" and help enhance related effects. Most of the old perks can also be used together with the ghoul perks. Just some that e.g. have to do with hunger and thirst are not usable because the ghoul is not hungry or thirsty.

### Luminaires & High Luminaire Values

"High glow values" means a value of >=180, the glow is your ghoul shield that reflects your hit point bar and is filled by absorbing radiation. So if you have 240 HP and your glow bar is filled by 75% or more, your value is above or equal to 180 and you have "high glow". If you have more TP, this percentage number will of course vary downwards.

## All new Ghoul Perk cards

### Arms of Steel (Strength)

Your powerful arms improve your ranged weapon handling and increase accuracy by 15%/30%.

![Ghoul Perk Card: Arms of Steel](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-perks-20241225154509-1.jpg) 

### Bone Shatterer (Strength)

15%/30%/45% chance to cripple a body part with your melee weapon attacks.

![Ghoul Perk Card: Bone Shatterer](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-perks-20241225154514-1.jpg) 

### Brick Wall (English: Brick Wall) (Strength)

Immunity to stagger attacks at high glow values.

![Ghoul Perk Card: Brick Wall](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-perks-20241225154517-1.jpg) 

### Radioactive Strength (English: Radioactive Strength) (Strength)

Consume a medium amount of glow and deal 50/100/150% more damage with strong attacks and strikes.

*Note: This perk currently works with automatic melee weapons. However, this is a bug and is not intended. A very high light consumption is planned so that auto-melee weapons cannot be used with it.*

![Ghoul Perk Card: Radioactive Strength](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-perks-20241225154520-1.jpg) 

### Breathe Deeply (English: Breathe It In) (Perception)

Radiation resistance is reduced by 50/100/150.

![Ghoul Perk Card: Breathe It In](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-perks-20241225154540-1.jpg) 

### Eye of the Hunter (Perception)

Your good vision gives you the V.A.T.S. at very long distances +20/+25/+30% precision.

![Ghoul Perk Card: Eye of the Hunter](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-perks-2025-03-05-15-42-59.jpg) 

### RAD Raider (English: Wheel Reaver) (Perception)

Non-automatic melee damage grants a small amount of glow.

![Ghoul Perk Card: Rad Reaver](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-perks-20241225154546-1.jpg) 

### Glowing Hunter (Perception)

50% chance of traces of glowing blood appearing on animal corpses.

![Ghoul Perk Card: Glowing Hunter](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-perks-20241225154548-1.jpg) 

### Glowing Gut (Stamina)

Irradiated food and drink grant 100/200/300% more RADs.

![Ghoul Perk Card: Glowing Gut](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ghoul-perks-20241225154608-1.jpg) 

### Radiation Power (Endurance)

Consume a small amount of glow per hit to deal 10/15/20% bonus damage to targets.
